rows.title: Lookalike domains are not the service
rows.defect: any host containing the domain counts
rows.test: hulu.com.evil.example and myhulu.com are not confirmed

rows.title: Every sender line on the domain
rows.defect: one matching sender line is enough
rows.test: a Reply-To elsewhere is not confirmed

rows.title: The forwarder is not the sender
rows.defect: the whole forwarded text is read for senders
rows.test: a forwarded real offer is still confirmed

rows.title: No From line is not confirmed
rows.defect: an empty sender list counts as on the domain
rows.test: an email with no From: line can't be confirmed

rows.title: The email's own date
rows.defect: the email's date is never read

rows.title: No year is never invented
rows.defect: a missing year is filled with this year

rows.title: A missing end date is said
rows.defect: a missing end date is left out silently
rows.test: no end date says the email doesn't say

rows.title: The after-promo price
rows.defect: the after-promo words are never recognised
rows.test: 'then $9.99' is the price after, not a second offer

rows.title: Several prices are not picked between
rows.defect: the first of several prices is taken as the offer
rows.test: two offer prices are listed and no saving is worked out

rows.title: An amount off is not a price
rows.defect: '$5 off' is read as a $5 price
rows.test: '$5 off' is quoted as a discount

rows.title: The charge before the cancellation
rows.test: a charge after the cancellation is not the regular price

rows.title: Pending charges are left out
rows.test: a pending charge is not what the person paid

rows.title: Only completed cancellations
rows.defect: any cancellation case counts, whatever its state
rows.test: a declined cancellation is not a cancellation

rows.title: The saving over the stated months
rows.defect: the total is one month's gap

rows.title: No saving for an untrusted offer
rows.defect: the saving is worked out whoever sent it
rows.test: a spoofed sender gets no saving worked out
